description: Cross-SDK golden vectors for trust-manifest freshness verdicts (chainlinker_modernization_12f_e / ADR-029 §D5). The Go, Python, and JS SDK freshness helpers MUST produce byte-identical verdict_line strings and identical age_days/stale/rollback_detected booleans for every case. v1 semantics: advisory report + warn, never hard-fail; rollback detection is stateful-only (last_seen_version < 0 => stateless, no rollback).
